name: Strigoi
description: Vampiric undead of Romanian folklore, distinguished from many other European vampire traditions by an active 'living' form (strigoi viu, a sorcerer or witch) and a 'dead' form (strigoi mort) that rises from the grave to torment family members.

aliases.name: Strigoi viu
aliases.meaning: 'Living strigoi' — sorcerer or witch with strigoi powers

aliases.name: Pricolici
aliases.meaning: Werewolf-strigoi crossover; undead transforming into a wolf

origin: Folk traditions of Romania, especially rural Wallachia, Moldavia, Transylvania, and Oltenia. Cognate beliefs extend across the Balkans and into the Slavic world.
